adversarialFindings.finding: An EXISTING test asserts the defect as a specification. src/lib/pe-checkout-tier.test.ts:169 'NOT-VACUOUS CONTROL: 404 feature-detect DOES reach the install-scoped fallback' asserts calls.length===2 and calls[1].url===LEGACY_INSTALL_SCOPED_URL. The fix makes it fail.
adversarialFindings.enforcementRule: ENFORCEMENT.md Tests: 'Never assert a value the system produces that no external authority recognises. That converts a defect into a specification and makes the fix read as a regression.' This is that exact shape.
adversarialFindings.resolution: REPLACE, not delete-and-move-on. The test existed to keep the 503 test non-vacuous. Its replacement must restore non-vacuity by a different discriminator that survives the retirement: a 200 case that still returns ok:true. If the whole function were broken into blanket refusal, that control fails. Reported explicitly in the close so the planner sees a defect-asserting test was removed, not weakened.

adversarialFindings.finding: The dispatch says a 403/404 click 'would silently charge every customer the wrong price'. Code reading says otherwise on the deployed surface. The fallback posts to CORTEX_PROXY_BASE + '/brokerage/v1/property-explorer/billing/checkout' = /api/spine/cortex/api/brokerage/v1/property-explorer/billing/checkout. api/spine.ts:311 runs isCortexBrowsePathAllowed FIRST and 403s outright; its POST branch (spine.ts:144-150) allows exactly four paths, none of them billing. The cortexPostPaths entry 'api/brokerage/v1/property-explorer/billing' at spine.ts:346 sits BELOW that early return and is unreachable dead configuration on this surface — a starved allowlist.
adversarialFindings.secondMechanismConsidered: That the browse gate is not deployed, or does not cover this path — which would make the wrong-charge real. Rejected by live probe, see liveProbes below.
adversarialFindings.consequence: The realized behaviour today is a confusing failure, not a wrong charge: the user sees the proxy's internal message 'Anonymous browse proxy allows facet/envelope/map-data paths only...' as their checkout error. The fix is still required — the code ENCODES the intent to charge Pro, and spine.ts:346 already names the path, so widening the browse gate by one line makes the downgrade real and silent. But the close must not overstate present-tense money risk.

adversarialFindings.severity: higher than the dispatch's own item 1
adversarialFindings.finding: The real live exposure to the retired Pro price is item 3, not item 1. /api/pe-billing bypasses spine.ts entirely (own rewrite, vercel.json:42), attaches Authorization: Bearer CORTEX_SERVICE_API_KEY server-side, and forwards the caller's body verbatim to the install-scoped seam. Its only gate is a self-asserted X-Hauska-Install-Id header of length >= 8, which any caller can invent.
adversarialFindings.status: PROPOSE retirement, do not perform — it is a deployed public route and removing it changes deployed routing. Handed back per dispatch item 3.

liveProbes.caveat: These measure the DEPLOYED artifact, which per fleet memory does not auto-deploy on merge and may lag origin/main de0dca7. Code findings above are stated against de0dca7; probes are stated against the deployed artifact.
